assumptions.statement: 15:30 remains a design probe for testing the school-to-community handoff chain, not an asserted dismissal time for a kindergarten in Beijing, Haidian or the project area. The user-provided background range (most kindergartens 16:00–17:00, many public kindergartens around 16:30, some extended services to 18:00 or later) remains unverified background and may not be promoted to a project fact.
assumptions.reason: No named project-area kindergarten, current operating timetable, class-level staggered-dismissal schedule or service rule has been supplied. The registered Haidian official pages support kindergarten-specific follow-up, not a dismissal-time value; the Huaibei page is a non-transferable local case.
required_inputs: handoff roles, named human responsibility and physical-receipt rule
document version, effective period, publisher and verification date
assumptions.release_condition: Release a kindergarten-specific operating time only after all required inputs are obtained from the named kindergarten or competent authority, cross-checked for the same effective term and service type, and recorded with version/effective-period provenance. Until then keep 15:30 explicitly labelled as a design probe and keep all actual dismissal/service windows unknown.
prohibited_interpretations: Do not treat 15:30 as an existing or official dismissal time.
Do not convert the user-provided national background range into a Beijing, Haidian, project-area or named-kindergarten fact.
Do not treat a public-kindergarten roster, telephone consultation time or admission FAQ as an operating timetable.
Do not extrapolate the Huaibei 18:00 local case to another city or kindergarten.
Do not merge ordinary dismissal, extended service, temporary late pickup and emergency retention into one time window.
Do not release a time without its named kindergarten, version, effective period, service type and responsible human handoff chain.

accessibility, fire, traffic, municipal, drainage and maintenance review as applicable
ownership, public-right and named responsibility record

assumptions.release_condition: For each object × field pair, record the existing condition, applicable statutory/official input, named reviewing role and decision to retain/revise/remove. A target may not fill an unknown. Any released change triggers package-wide metrics, figure, HTML and PDF regeneration.
prohibited_interpretations: Do not treat a concept target as an existing dimension.
Do not treat a concept target as a statutory minimum or maximum.
Do not infer a public right, navigation line, construction dimension or operating readiness.
Do not use schema sanity ranges as planning values.
